L_odot: Solar luminosity, the unit of luminosity
M_odot: Solar mass, the unit of stellar mass
N_left: Number of stars that have left the main sequence
R_odot: Solar radius, the unit of radius
a: Exponent of the mass and luminosity power law, L ∝ Mᵃ
t: Time: a star's main sequence lifetime, or the cluster's age
x: Exponent of the initial mass function, dN/dM ∝ M⁻ˣ
